data.title: Application for Marriage License
data.desc: Application for a Marriage License (AML) at the City Civil Registrar's Office for parties seeking to contract marriage.
requirements: Certificate of No Marriage (CENOMAR) - (1 original & 1 photocopy)
Pre-Marriage Counseling Seminar Certificate from CHO - (1 original)
Birth Certificate / Baptismal / Voter's Certification - (2 photocopies)
Barangay Certification - (1 original & 1 photocopy)
Recent CEDULA - (2 photocopies)
Valid ID of Applicants (National, UMID, SSS, Passport, etc.) - (2 photocopies)

docs: Personal appearance of parents
Valid IDs of parents - (2 photocopies)
Death Certificate of Deceased Spouse - (2 photocopies)
Annotated Marriage Certificate
LCR Certificate of Registration - (2 photocopies)
Certificate of Legal Capacity from Embassy
Passport with arrival date - (2 photocopies)

guidelines.action: Fill out the Application for Marriage License and submit complete requirements to the CCRO for assessment and tracking barcode attachment.
Secure an Order of Payment and proceed to the City Treasurer's Office to pay the required fees (approx. PHP 525.00 - PHP 750.00).
Submit the Official Receipt to CCRO, undergo image capturing, and register biometrics.
Return to the CCRO to claim the owner's copy of the Marriage License through biometric verification.

data.title: Medical Outpatient Consultation and Treatment Services
data.desc: Primary Health Care Services including diagnosis, treatment of illnesses, and appropriate medical services for Panabo City constituents and eligible beneficiaries.
requirements: Referral Slip - (1 Original Copy)
Individual Treatment Record
Consent Form - (1 Original Copy)
Philhealth ID, MDR, or any valid ID (National, SSS, Passport, etc.)

docs: Payment of PHP 30.00 Fee
Payment of PHP 50.00 Fee

situational_requirements.condition: Priority Groups (4Ps, IP, and NHTS beneficiaries)
docs: Proof of membership for Free (None) services

guidelines.action: Submit Referral Slip, fill-out records, and present valid ID for vital signs and assessment.
Proceed to the consultation or treatment room for medical examination, diagnosis, or nursing health services.
Go to the Cashier at the City Treasurer's Office Satellite Office to pay required fees and secure an Official Receipt.

data.title: Availment of Animal Bite Treatment
data.desc: This service intends to give appropriate medication of animal bite cases to prevent death due to rabies and promotes advocacy of responsible pet ownership.
requirements: Referral Slip from Barangay Health Station - (1 Original Copy)
Individual Treatment Record from CHO-Outpatient and Safe Birthing Facility
Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (PEP) or Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis Card/Slip from CHO-Animal Bite Treatment Center
Philhealth Member Data Record - (Original or photocopy) from PhilHealth Office
Valid ID - (Original or photocopy) of any Government office

docs: 1 Original Copy from the City Mayor's Office
Free of charge if vaccine is available from DOH or PhilHealth Animal Bite Package
Patient will secure it if not available

guidelines.action: Submit the Referral Slip and wait for vital signs to be taken at the CHO-Outpatient and Safe Birthing Facility.
Proceed to the Consultation Room for patient examination and prescription.
Return to the Nurse's Station to carry out orders, receive health instructions, and Tetanus Toxoid if ordered.
Proceed to the PhilHealth and Accreditation Services Unit located in front of the Nurse's Station.
Proceed to the Animal Bite treatment room for patient registration and administration of necessary treatment/vaccines.

data.title: Issuance of Medical Certificate
data.desc: Medical certificate is issued as requirement or supporting document for employment purposes, remand, school requirements, travel and others.
requirements: Vital signs result from City Health Office - (1 Original Copy)
Request Form from City Health Office - (1 Original Copy)

situational_requirements.condition: For Employment (Public & Private) and Other Purposes
docs: Result of Complete Blood Count (CBC) from CHO Laboratory Section - (1 Original Copy)
Result of Urinalysis (specimen < 1 hour old) from CHO Laboratory Section - (1 Original Copy)
Result of Stool Exam/Fecalysis (specimen < 1 hour old) from CHO Laboratory Section - (1 Original Copy)
Result of X-ray (not more than 6 months old) from Private Diagnostic Centers/Hospitals - (1 Original Copy)
Fee: PHP 60.00
Medical Endorsement from Police Station - (1 Original Copy)
Result of Complete Blood Count (CBC) from CHO Laboratory Section - (1 Original Copy)
Fee: PHP 30.00
Result of X-ray (not more than 6 months old) from Private Diagnostic Centers/Hospitals - (1 Original Copy)

guidelines.action: Fill-out the request form and submit the complete requirements to the Nurse/Health Worker for assessment and encoding.
Secure an Order of Payment and proceed to the City Treasurer’s Office-Satellite Office to pay the required fee and secure an Official Receipt.
Return to the Nurse at the CHO-Outpatient to present the Official Receipt, sign the logbook, and claim the Medical Certificate.

data.title: Legal Consultation
data.desc: The City Legal Office provides free legal consultation/advice to walk-in clients, City/Barangay Officials and employees. Client's concerns/problems are responded to and acted upon with legal advice.
requirements: None

docs: Relevant/factual information and/or present necessary supporting documents relative to the concern

guidelines.action: Fill-out the logbook and state the purpose of the visit at the City Legal Office.
Wait for the endorsement of the case to the assigned legal officer/authorized officer.
Narrate the problem/concern by providing honest and relevant/factual information and/or present necessary supporting documents.
Receive the legal advice rendered by the Legal Officer/Authorized Officer.

data.title: Legal Assistance
data.desc: The City Legal Office provides free legal assistance to walk-in clients, including the drafting of legal instruments (formal sworn statements of facts) signed by the affiant and/or witnesses.
requirements: Competent Evidence of Identity (Government Issued ID card) such as PhilID, GSIS, UMID, PRC, SSS, COMELEC, LTO, DFA Passport, BIR, Pag-IBIG, or Senior Citizen ID from issuing Government Office
Other supporting documents original/certified true copy from Client's file copy
Credible witness/es who has personal knowledge or can attest to a fact or event of the affiant/client

docs: Affidavits
Special Power of Attorney

guidelines.action: Fill-out the logbook and state the purpose of the visit for a preliminary interview and referral.
Provide honest and relevant information for interview, clarification, and document validation for the preparation of legal instruments.
Claim the requested legal instrument once recorded and released by the staff.

data.title: Application for Land New Assessment and Transfer
data.desc: The application for transfer of Ownership is processed if the requester wishes to update or change the existing records for new ownership.
requirements: Letter of consent or authorization letter of the property owner from the Property Owner - (1 original copy) / Special Power of Attorney SPA (1 photocopy) from a Law Office
Photocopy of Government ID of owner with 3 signatures from the Property Owner - (1 photocopy)
Photocopy of Government ID of the requestor with 3 signatures from the Requestor - (1 photocopy)
Certified True copy of Title (OCT, TCT & CCT) from the Registry of Deeds - (1 original certified copy)
Deed of Conveyance, Deed of Donation, Deed of Sale, Extra-judicial Settlement & etc. from a Law Office or Registry of Deeds - (1 photocopy)
Official Receipt of Transfer Fee from the City Treasurer's Office or Registry of Deeds - (1 photocopy)
Tax Clearance from the City Treasurer's Office - (1 photocopy)
Assessors Fee Receipt from the City Treasurer's Office - (1 original copy)

guidelines.action: Submit complete documentary requirements at Appraisal and Assessment Section (Window 1) and secure an Order of Payment.
Go to the City Treasurer’s Office and secure priority number at queuing machine and wait for the number to be called to pay assigned fees (PHP 225.00) in Window 3-5.
Return to the CASSO Appraisal and Assessment Section to give the official receipt, sign the FAAS, and receive the Claim Stub for ocular inspection and technical processing.
Return to the CASSO Records Management Section (Window 6) and present the Claim Stub to claim the Tax Declaration with Notice of Assessment.

data.title: Issuance of Senior Citizens ID
data.desc: The senior citizen ID refers to the card issued by the OSCA office of the city or municipality where the elderly individual lives. This locally-issued ID is honored nationwide and is vital for the availment of privileges under Republic Act No. 9994.
requirements: Registration Form (OSCA Form No. 1) from Senior Citizen Day Center, New Pandan, P.C
Birth Certificate from Philippine Statistics Authority / City Civil Registrar Office - (1 Photocopy)
Barangay Certificate from Barangay Hall - (1 Original Copy)
2 pcs. 1x1 ID pic from Requesting Client
SC President Certificate from Office of the Barangay Association President of Senior Citizen - (1 Original Copy)

guidelines.action: Fill-out the registration form and submit complete requirements at the Office of the Senior Citizen Affairs (OSCA) Office.
Wait for the printing of the ID and check the correctness of the ID upon receipt.
Affix a signature to the ID and the logbook as proof of receipt.

data.title: Issuance of Senior Citizens Purchase Booklet
data.desc: The Office issues Purchase Slip Booklets to senior citizens to enable them avail of the 20% discount on medicines and 5% discount on basic necessities provided by Law (RA 9257).
requirements: Senior Citizens ID from Senior Citizen Day Center, New Pandan, P.C

guidelines.action: Present Senior Citizen ID at the Office of the Senior Citizen Affairs (OSCA) Office for validity checking.
Receive the Booklet and affix signature to the ID and the Office’s Logbook as proof of receipt.

data.title: Application for Scholarship Program
data.desc: The Scholarship Program offers three educational grants (Iskolar ng Lungsod, Study Grant for IPs/Muslims, and Ladderized Educational grant) to students and high school graduates who are bonafide residents of Panabo City under City Ordinance no. 24-2020.
requirements: Scholarship Program Application Form (1 original)
Photo ID: 2x2 picture (1 piece) and 2x3 picture (1 piece)
Certification of Annual Gross Income and/or Affidavit of Low Income (income does not exceed P 60,000.00) (1 photocopy)
School Credentials (1 certified true copy): Form 138-A or Report Card
Certificate of Good Moral Character
Certificate of Residency (at least one (1) year and without derogatory record) (1 photocopy)
Certification from the Barangay that the applicant is the only member of the family to avail the Scholarship grant (1 photocopy)

docs: Certificate of Indigency/Muslim

guidelines.action: Submit the documentary requirements and fill out the Scholarship Program Application Form at Receiving desk.
Take the Qualifying written examination and interview at the designated room assignment.
Attend the Scholarship Orientation and receive the Certificate of Recognition.
Submit the filled out Assessment form for processing of scholarship grant.
